MP005:p0068:t01:r001:c01.text: Operation of the pump at incorrect bearing temperature could damage the pump.

MP005:p0068:t01:r002:c01.text: Make sure that the bearing temperature of the pump (set) is not more than 90 C

MP005:p0068:t01:r003:c01.text: (measured on the outside of the motor housing).

MP005:p0068:t02:r000:c01.text: NOTE: After commissioning, increased temperatures may occur at grease-lubricated rolling

MP005:p0068:t02:r001:c01.text: element bearing due to the running-in process. The final bearing temperature is only reached

MP005:p0068:t02:r002:c01.text: after a certain period of operation (up to 48 hours depending on the conditions).
